Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Karan - 35 years, son
Look: light beard, green T-shirt
2. Shalini - 57 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez
3. Nitin - 68 years, father
Look: glasses, brown sweater
4. Suresh - 38 years, friend
Look: glasses, brown sweater
5. Sunita - 31 years, daughter
Look: pink kurta, a long plait

Places

1. The office - desks, computers, a glass wall

Scene 1: The office - Day

[Karan stands in the office. Shalini and Suresh stand near him.]

Shalini: "What lovely weather!"

[Karan clutches his chest, collapses with a heart attack and dies.]

Shalini: "Rest in peace."
